Extract the nowcast variance from a fit object

Source: R/backcast.R
retrieve_nowcast_var.Rd

Extract the nowcast variance from a fit object

Usage

retrieve_nowcast_var(fit, model = c("ar", "wai"))

Arguments

fit

A fit object from run_ar() or run_wai_adj().

model

Character, which kind of fit fit is: "ar" for the AR benchmark (whose nowcast is already a single value) or "wai" for the dynamic factor model (whose nowcast is a series, of which the last value is taken). Matched with match.arg().

Value

The nowcast variance.

See also

Other backcasting functions: retrieve_nowcast()

Examples

fit <- list(nowcast_var = stats::ts(c(0.02, 0.04), start = 2024, frequency = 4))
retrieve_nowcast_var(fit, model = "wai")
#>      Qtr2
#> 2024 0.04
